scope: control-only immutable source payload plus separate mode-editable state and provenance-bound acyclic operation history

proposed_work_order.fixed_operation_semantics: historical name; only editable state changes, exactly one existing fault.mode changes, immutable source payload/ref/record/axes/identities never change
proposed_work_order.future_mapping: T1 only, fresh same-candidate source-backed lossless mapping into CandidateStatePackageV5Next

source_record_contract.record_ref_semantics: exact URI/version/hash triple; must equal source record fields byte-for-byte

source_payload_ref_contract.source_record_ref_semantics: nested exact G3ControlSourceRecordRefV1 containing source-record URI/version/hash
source_payload_ref_contract.immutable_fields: candidate, parent, actual additive child contract, source URI/version, source-record ref/hash and source-content hash

physical_resolution_contract.terminal_deferred_rule: reason is non-empty typed text; evidence_ref is nothing or a real external receipt ref; local software cannot promote status

operation_history_contract.operation_hash_recipe: H(canonical(operation_id, operation_kind, key, fault_id, expected_prior_mode, resulting_mode, previous_state_hash, expected_prior_source_content_hash, source_record_ref, source_payload_ref))
operation_history_contract.resulting_state_hash_recipe: H(canonical(key, state_status, source_payload_ref, editable_body_after, initial_source_content_hash, initial_state_hash, previous_state_hash, prior_operation_hashes_in_order, operation_hash, contract_admission, physical_resolution))
operation_history_contract.duplicate_and_order_rule: operation_id, operation_hash and fault_id+previous_state_hash globally unique; each previous hash equals prior state hash; tuple order immutable

five_hash_layers: source_record_hash: H(canonical(source_uri, source_version, all four complete slots)); own and downstream hashes excluded
source_content_hash: H(canonical(key, parent ref/hash, actual child contract/ref hash, source URI/version, complete source_record_ref, complete body)); own hash excluded

initial_state_hash: H(canonical(status, source ref/body/hash or typed-absent marker, admission, typed physical resolution, ZERO_DIGEST operation, typed empty history)); status included and hash frozen

operation_hash: H(canonical(operation identity, key, modes, previous_state_hash, expected source hash, exact source_record_ref, exact source_payload_ref)); operation and resulting state hash fields excluded

resulting_state_hash: H(canonical(state identity, immutable source ref, editable body, initial hashes, previous_state_hash, prior operation hashes in order, new operation_hash, statuses)); no resulting hash is an input

zero_rules.typed_absent: source_payload_ref/editable_body/initial_source_content_hash=nothing, typed empty history, last_operation_hash=ZERO_DIGEST, current_state_hash==initial_state_hash, no edit admitted

canonical_bytes.numbers: normalized exact Rational{Int64}; no floats or locale formatting
canonical_bytes.failure_rule: every failure returns the old state's canonical bytes exactly unchanged, including all history, hashes, absence markers and statuses

required_negative_controls: open/wrong-typed body, duplicate IDs, bad refs, direction/unit/cardinality/controller/fault/plan mismatch -> fail_closed
missing provenance -> typed_absent and terminal_deferred without fabricated hash
independent recomputation of all five hashes and exact source-record-ref checks
valid one-mode edit preserves immutable source and initial identity and changes only editable state/history/operation/current hash
stale source/state, forged hashes, source-ref mismatch, non-mode or multi-fault change, unsupported mode, duplicate/reordered history -> fail_closed with old canonical state bytes unchanged
typed-absent edit, dynamic path, insert/delete/rebind and old V5/package/registry/T0/realization/binding/feedback substitution -> rejected
review_requirement: different Luna independently reviews R4 before implementation dispatch
